definitions.explanation: A shortened form of a name or title, especially of an organization, law, or technical term. Refers to the abbreviated name itself, not the act of abbreviating.

examples.japanese: 「UN」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「United Nations」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略称|りゃくしょう}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略称|りゃくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「マイナンバー⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: This law is commonly referred to by its abbreviated name, 'the My Number Act.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{長|なが}すぎる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略称|りゃくしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Because the official name is too long, the abbreviated name is often used in daily life.

notes:
USAGE:
{略称|りゃくしょう} refers specifically to shortened names of organizations, laws, and formal titles. It is the product of abbreviation, not the process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略称|りゃくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (call by the abbreviated name)
- ⟦{正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{略称|りゃくしょう} (official name and abbreviation)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略称|りゃくしょう} (abbreviation of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: abbreviation, acronym (shortened words in general, including everyday abbreviations)
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission, abbreviation (the act of leaving something out or shortening)
- {頭文字|かしらもじ}: initials, acronym (abbreviation using first letters)
